title: A particle method for the Boltzmann equation via amortized sampling from Green's function of the lifted linear operator
summary: The collision operator for the Boltzmann equation is a nonlinear nonlocal operator. When lifted in the extended 2-particle space, it is viewed as the projection of a collisional linear operator. In this paper, we propose a particle method that samples the post-collision relative velocity directly from the Green's function of this operator (the transition probability of the generated time-continuous Markov chain).
